typography.strategy: High-contrast editorial typography paired with a clean sans-serif UI for dashboard density. Headings carry the Sogrape heritage and luxury feel; body copy ensures optimal readability for data.

hierarchy.data_label: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground font-semibold

status_traffic_lights.description: 5-band traffic-light indicators. Used strictly for performance ratings. Bright colors only appear here, tuned to the wine palette.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous padding (p-8, p-12) for outer containers to create an airy, premium feel. Tight spacing (gap-4) for data density.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Persistent left sidebar, 260px width. Deep bordeaux in both themes, or ultra-dark bordeaux in dark mode. Expandable sections for 4 Perspectives.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento-style layout for KPIs. 3-4 column grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4) for data relation, but generous internal padding (p-6) in cards.
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Minimalist borders (1px solid border-border), flat backgrounds, subtle 8px border radius (rounded-lg). Avoid heavy box-shadows. Opt for a tactile, crisp editorial look.

components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary buttons use deep bordeaux. Accent buttons use muted gold. Hover states must shift lightness smoothly.
components.data_tables: Shadcn/UI tables. Sortable headers. Clean 1px border below rows. Left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers. Sticky headers for large datasets.
components.charts: Recharts. Radar chart for Perspective balance, Bar charts for Department comparisons, Trend lines for timeframe views. Gauge charts for Scorecard totals. Charts must inherit the brand palette (bordeaux, terracotta, gold).
components.strategy_map: React Flow. Use custom node components with bordeaux borders and subtle backgrounds. Edges should be smooth, animated stroke lines to show alignment across Perspectives.
components.inputs: Shadcn/UI forms. Explicit labels. Hover and focus states must use a delicate 2px ring in primary or accent color.
components.badges: Small pill badges with a dot and text. Used for status indicators and Performance Ratings.

entry_screen.description: Branded welcome moment leading to the portal.
entry_screen.visuals: Full-bleed vineyard/wine imagery or solid deep-bordeaux background. Centered logo lockup with two wine-glass SVG illustrations side by side.

setup_wizard.description: Guided setup workflow for Company details, Hierarchy, Vision/Mission, and Strategic Themes.
setup_wizard.layout: Centered card with a progress stepper. Editorial typography for prompts.

main_dashboard.description: The command center. 3 interchangeable views (Perspective, Department, Time Period).
main_dashboard.layout: Top bar with View toggles (Tabs). High-level KPI cards at the top. Charts (Radar, Trend) below. Data grid at the bottom.

strategy_map.description: Interactive flow of objectives rolling up into perspectives.
strategy_map.layout: Full width/height canvas using React Flow. Floating zoom/pan controls.

imagery.usage: Use vineyard photography in empty states, section headers, and the entry screen. Generous whitespace around imagery.

motion_and_interactions.general: Understated and premium. No garish or bouncy animations.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion: Fade in with a very slight upward translate (y: 10 to 0, opacity: 0 to 1, duration: 0.4s, ease: easeOut).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with a soft ambient shadow increase. Links feature a subtle underline expansion.
motion_and_interactions.react_flow: Use animated edges (stroke-dasharray) to show flow from Initiatives -> Targets -> Measures -> Objectives.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Never use pure black (#000000), use the Near-black Bordeaux (#1A1213).
Import Google Fonts: 'Playfair Display' for serif headings and 'Manrope' for body/UI text in index.html or global css.
In the entry screen, craft an elegant inline SVG for the two wine glasses to act as the illustration, using the muted gold and bordeaux stroke colors.
In the Strategy Map component, ensure React Flow custom nodes are styled as premium cards with subtle borders, not default gray boxes.
The 5-band traffic-light system must be clearly visible but not neon. Rely on the provided 'status_traffic_lights' hex codes.
Implement light and dark mode toggles. Both must look distinctly like a wine brand (cream/bordeaux vs. black-bordeaux/terracotta).
Ensure the dashboard uses Recharts. Example needed: Radar chart for Perspective weighting.
Integrate Lucide-react for iconography. Use light stroke widths if possible to maintain elegance.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; ensure readability via solid or slightly blurred backgrounds for dropdowns. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific property transitions.
NEVER center-align the main app container.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Avoid the 'Vercel default' look by adjusting Shadcn border radii and colors to match the heritage brand.
Use Sonner for toast notifications. Ensure toasts inherit the elegant serif/sans font stack.
For form inputs, use explicit focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent).
